source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.5.1, printed page 224.

blocks.text: Scientists ne Lamarck ke pesh kiye hue tabdeeli ke khayalat qabool nahin kiye. Jis zamane mein Lamarckism pesh hua us waqt koi aisa saboot maujood nahin tha jo evolution ka tareeqa (mechanism) samjha sake. Is liye Lamarck par tanqeed (criticism) zyada is baat par hui ke woh evolution, yaani tabdeeli, ke khayal ki himayat kar rahe the, na ke us tareeqe par jo unhon ne is tabdeeli ke liye bataya. Un ke baad jab scientists ne virasat (inheritance) ke tareeqe daryaft kiye to unhon ne in bunyadon par Lamarckism ko ghalat sabit kiya:

items: Acquired characters ki koi genetic bunyad (genes mein koi tabdeeli) nahin hoti, is liye yeh agli naslon mein muntaqil nahin ho sakte.
Aaza (organs) jandar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahin badalte.

blocks.title: Initiating and Planning
blocks.text: Hypothesis banayein (andaza lagayein) ke Lamarck par apne zamane mein tanqeed evolution ke khayal ki himayat karne par hui thi ya us tareeqe (mechanism) par jo unhon ne pesh kiya.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is ka jawab upar ke paragraph mein hai: us zamane mein Lamarck par zyada tanqeed evolution (tabdeeli) ke khayal ki himayat par hui, kyun ke tab tak evolution ka koi saboot nahin tha. Un ka tareeqa (acquired characters ki virasat) baad mein genetics ke daryaft hone par ghalat sabit hua.

blocks.prompt: Ek weightlifter ke muscles bare ho jate hain. Kya us ke bachche yeh bare muscles virasat mein payenge? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Bare muscles ek acquired character hain; is se sex cells (sperm ya egg) ke genes nahin badalte, is liye yeh bachchon mein nahin jate. Lamarckism par yahi bara aitraz hai.

items: Lamarck par tanqeed zyada evolution ke khayal ki himayat par hui, kyun ke us waqt koi saboot nahin tha.
Genetics ne Lamarckism ko radd kiya: acquired characters ki genetic bunyad nahin, is liye virasat mein nahin jate.
Aaza jandar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahin badalte.
